blocks.text: Asosiy qisqa shakllar qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 119-dars): I'm, you've, she'll, isn't, won't; **'s** = is / has, **'d** = would / had; qisqa javob va gap oxirida qisqartirilmasligi. Bu ilovada B1–B2 darajasidagi qiyin holatlar: qisqa shakl ot va so'roq so'zlaridan keyin, bitta gapda ikki xil **'d**, modal + **'ve** (should've), kam uchraydigan inkorlar (mightn't, daren't, shan't), inkor so'roqlar va eng muhimi — qayerda qisqa shakl to'g'ri, qayerda esa uslubga to'g'ri kelmaydi.

rows: Aziz**'s** left. The taxi**'ll** be here soon.
**'s** — yozuvda ham keng; **'ll**, **'d**, **'ve** — asosan og'zaki nutqda

blocks.text: Qisqa shaklni to'g'ri tushunish uchun doim **keyingi so'zga** qarang. Qizil kitobdagi qoida (V3 bo'lsa — has / had) B1–B2 da ham ishlaydi, lekin endi majhul nisbat (is + V3) va og'zaki nutqdagi kam uchraydigan ma'nolar qo'shiladi. Masalan, The shop**'s** closed — bu **is** (majhul / sifat: do'kon yopiq), The shop**'s** closed down — bu ham **is**? Yo'q: «closed down» — Present Perfect, demak **has** (do'kon butunlay yopilgan). Bunday holatda kontekst hal qiladi.

rows: keyin sifat, ot, `-ing`, majhul V3, joy
keyin been, got yoki faol ma'nodagi V3
The road**'s** been closed for a week.
keyin ot, gapda boshqa fe'l bor
keyin V1, have + V3, rather, like
I**'d** say no. I**'d** have said no.

items.text: The old cinema**'s** closed down, and they're building flats there.
items.translation: Eski kinoteatr **yopilib ketgan**, o'rnida uylar qurishyapti.

items.text: Where**'d** you get those boots? They look really warm.
items.translation: O'sha etiklarni qayerdan **olding**? Juda issiqqa o'xshaydi.

blocks.text: Uchinchi tur shart gapda (→ 40-dars) va o'zlashtirma gapda (→ 47–48-darslar) **'d** bitta gapning o'zida ikki ma'noda kelishi mumkin: If I**'d** known, I**'d** have come. Birinchisi — **had** (if dan keyin Past Perfect), ikkinchisi — **would** (keyin have + V3). Qoida o'zgarmaydi: keyingi so'zga qarang. Diqqat: **'d have** + V3 — har doim would have; **'d been** — had been (I'd been waiting), **'d be** — would be.

rows: It**'d be** a shame to miss it.
You**'d better** hurry. I**'d rather** walk.

items.text: If you**'d** asked me, I**'d** have lent you the money.
We**'d been** walking for hours before we found a café.
It**'d be** a shame to waste all this food.

blocks.text: O'tmish haqidagi modal shakllarda (→ 149-dars) **have** og'zaki nutqda va norasmiy yozuvda **'ve** ga qisqaradi: should**'ve**, could**'ve**, would**'ve**, must**'ve**, might**'ve**. Og'zaki nutqda bu «of» ga o'xshab eshitiladi, shuning uchun ona tilida so'zlashuvchilar ham «should of» deb yozib qo'yishadi — bu **xato**. Ikki marta qisqartirish (shouldn't've, wouldn't've) faqat og'zaki nutqda; yozuvda shouldn**'t have**.

items.text: You **should've** seen his face when he opened the present!
We **could've** walked — it's only ten minutes from here.
items.translation: Piyoda **borsak ham bo'lardi** — bu yerdan atigi o'n daqiqa.

blocks.text: Inkor so'roq va so'roq qo'shimchalarida (question tags) qisqa shakl deyarli majburiy: **Isn't** it cold? **Don't** you agree? It's late, **isn't** it? (→ 52-dars). To'liq shakl bilan so'roqda **not** egadan keyin keladi: **Is** it **not** true...? Bu juda rasmiy, nutqlar va sud zalida eshitiladi.

rows: I **am** listening! I **did not** say that!

items: Darak qisqa javob va gap oxiri: Yes, she **has**. («Yes, she's.» emas) Do you know where he **is**? (qizil kitobdan eslatma);
**have** va **had** asosiy fe'l bo'lsa: I **have** a meeting at ten (yoki I**'ve got**); «I've a car» — eskirgan, «I'd a shower» — xato: I **had** a shower;
`-s`, `-sh`, `-ch`, `-x` bilan tugaydigan otdan keyin yozuvda: The bus **is** late («The bus's late» emas);
Rasmiy matnda va urg'u kerak bo'lganda — yuqoridagi jadvalga qarang;
Ikki marta qisqartirish (I'd've, wouldn't've) — yozuvda yo'q.

blocks.text: Filmlar, qo'shiqlar va chatlarda **gonna** (going to), **wanna** (want to), **gotta** (have got to), **dunno** (don't know), **ain't** (am not / isn't / haven't) kabi shakllarni ko'p uchratasiz. Ularni tushunish foydali, lekin bular standart grammatika emas: insho, imtihon, ish xati va rasmiy nutqda ishlatmang.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I should of called.» → I should**'ve** / should **have** called; «If I would have known...» → If I**'d** known (= had known); «The shop's closed down» ni «do'kon yopiq» deb tushunish → **has** closed down — butunlay yopilgan; «I amn't sure.» → I**'m not** sure; «I'd a lot of work yesterday.» → I **had** a lot of work; rasmiy xat yoki IELTS inshosida «I'm», «don't», «it's» → I **am**, **do not**, **it is**; «can not» → **cannot** (bitta so'z) yoki **can't**.

Ikki savol bering: 1) **Keyingi so'z** nima? — V3 / been bo'lsa: 's = has, 'd = had; V1 / have bo'lsa: 'd = would. 2) **Kim o'qiydi?** — do'st yoki hamkasb bo'lsa, qisqa shakl tabiiy; komissiya, imtihonchi yoki rasmiy idora bo'lsa — to'liq shakl.

rows: V3, been, better → had; V1, have, rather → would
I **am** writing..., I **did not** say that!

examples.title: **'s** after nouns and question words: is or has?
examples.description: 's olmoshdan tashqari ot, ism, so'roq so'zi va everything / nobody dan keyin ham keladi. is yoki has ekanini keyingi so'z va kontekst ko'rsatadi; ismdan keyin ot kelsa — egalik.

sentences.text: **Who's** taken my phone charger? It was on the desk a minute ago.
sentences.translation: Telefon zaryadlovchimni kim **olib qo'ydi**? Bir daqiqa oldin stol ustida edi.

sentences.text: **Where's** Anvar gone? His coat isn't here.
sentences.translation: Anvar qayoqqa **ketdi**? Paltosi bu yerda yo'q.

sentences.text: The weather**'s been** awful all week, so the picnic**'s** cancelled.
sentences.translation: Hafta bo'yi ob-havo dahshatli **bo'ldi**, shuning uchun piknik bekor **qilindi**.

sentences.text: Everything**'s** ready — we can start as soon as the guests arrive.
sentences.translation: Hammasi **tayyor** — mehmonlar kelishi bilan boshlaymiz.

sentences.text: Nobody**'s** called this morning, which is strange for a Monday.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab hech kim **qo'ng'iroq qilmadi**, dushanba uchun bu g'alati.

sentences.text: My brother**'s** just been offered a job in Seoul.
sentences.translation: Akamga hozirgina Seulda ish **taklif qilishdi**.

sentences.text: How long**'s** she been working at the embassy?
sentences.translation: U elchixonada qancha vaqtdan beri **ishlayapti**?

sentences.text: This soup**'s** delicious — what**'s** in it?
sentences.translation: Bu sho'rva juda **mazali** — ichida nima **bor**?

sentences.text: Your **sister's** car**'s been** parked outside our gate since Friday.
sentences.translation: **Opangizning** mashinasi jumadan beri darvozamiz oldida **turibdi**.

sentences.text: What**'s** happened to the lift? It**'s** making a terrible noise.
sentences.translation: Liftga nima **bo'ldi**? Dahshatli ovoz **chiqaryapti**.

examples.title: **'d** = had or would? If I**'d** known, I**'d** have come
examples.description: 'd dan keyin V3 yoki been kelsa — had; V1 yoki have + V3 kelsa — would. Shart gapda ikkalasi bir gapda. 'd better = had better, 'd rather = would rather; og'zaki nutqda Where'd = Where did.

sentences.text: If I**'d** known you were ill, I**'d** have brought you some soup.
sentences.translation: Kasal ekaningni **bilganimda**, senga sho'rva olib kelgan **bo'lardim**.

sentences.text: She said she**'d** already paid the bill.
sentences.translation: U hisobni allaqachon **to'lab qo'yganini** aytdi.

sentences.text: We**'d** love to come to your wedding, but we'll be in Dubai then.
sentences.translation: To'yingizga **kelishni juda xohlardik**, lekin o'sha paytda Dubayda bo'lamiz.

sentences.text: You**'d** better charge your phone before the trip.
sentences.translation: Safardan oldin telefoningni **quvvatlab olganing ma'qul**.

sentences.text: Jasur**'d** never flown before, so he was quite nervous at the airport.
sentences.translation: Jasur ilgari hech qachon **samolyotda uchmagan edi**, shuning uchun aeroportda ancha hayajonlandi.

sentences.text: I**'d** rather take the train than drive in this weather.
sentences.translation: Bunday ob-havoda mashina haydagandan ko'ra, poyezdda **borganim afzal**.

sentences.text: Who**'d** have thought that our little village would become a tourist attraction?
sentences.translation: Kichik qishlog'imiz sayyohlar maskaniga aylanishini kim **o'ylabdi** deysiz?

sentences.text: They**'d** been driving for six hours when the engine started smoking.
sentences.translation: Dvigateldan tutun chiqa boshlaganda, ular olti soatdan beri **mashina haydab kelayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: It**'d** be great if you could join us for dinner on Friday.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni kechki ovqatga qo'shilsangiz, **ajoyib bo'lardi**.

sentences.text: Where**'d** you put the car keys? — On the shelf by the door.
sentences.translation: Mashina kalitlarini qayerga **qo'yding**? — Eshik yonidagi tokchaga.

examples.title: **should've**, **could've**, **must've**: modal + 've
examples.description: Og'zaki nutq va norasmiy yozuvda modal + have qisqaradi: should've, could've, would've, must've, might've. Yozuvda inkor bilan — shouldn't have; «should of» — xato.

sentences.text: You **should've** told me you were coming — I'd have cooked something special.
sentences.translation: Kelishingni **aytishing kerak edi** — maxsus biror narsa pishirgan bo'lardim.

sentences.text: We **could've** caught the earlier train if you hadn't stopped for coffee.
sentences.translation: Qahva uchun to'xtamaganingda, oldingi poyezdga **ulgurishimiz mumkin edi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **must've** left her umbrella in the taxi.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza soyabonini taksida **qoldirgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: I **would've** called you, but my battery was dead.
sentences.translation: Senga **qo'ng'iroq qilgan bo'lardim**, lekin telefonim o'chib qolgan edi.

sentences.text: The fire **might've** started in the kitchen, the firefighters think.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilarning fikricha, yong'in oshxonada **boshlangan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Honestly, you **shouldn't have** paid for everyone — let me give you some money.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, hamma uchun **to'lamasligingiz kerak edi** — sizga pul berib qo'yay.

sentences.text: Who **could've** guessed that the shy boy from our class would become a famous actor?
sentences.translation: Sinfimizdagi o'sha uyatchang bola mashhur aktyor bo'lishini kim **taxmin qila olardi**?

sentences.text: It **must've** been hard for you to move to a new country on your own.
sentences.translation: Yangi mamlakatga yolg'iz ko'chib borish siz uchun qiyin **bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Look at the time! We **should've** left half an hour ago.
sentences.translation: Soatga qara! Yarim soat oldin **chiqib ketishimiz kerak edi**.

sentences.text: Without the satnav, we **would've** got completely lost in the old town.
sentences.translation: Navigatorsiz eski shaharda butunlay **adashib qolgan bo'lardik**.

examples.title: **'ll** after nouns: **That'll**, **There'll**, **the doctor'll**
examples.description: 'll (= will) olmoshdan tashqari ot, ism, that / there / who / what dan keyin ham keladi — og'zaki nutqda va norasmiy yozuvda. Inkori — won't.

sentences.text: **That'll** be eighteen thousand soums, please — cash or card?
sentences.translation: Hammasi o'n sakkiz ming so'm **bo'ladi** — naqd yoki karta?

sentences.text: **There'll** be a short break after the second presentation.
sentences.translation: Ikkinchi taqdimotdan keyin qisqa tanaffus **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: The doctor**'ll** see you in a few minutes, Mrs Rahimova.
sentences.translation: Shifokor sizni bir necha daqiqadan keyin **qabul qiladi**, Rahimova xonim.

sentences.text: **Who'll** look after the cat while we're away?
sentences.translation: Biz yo'qligimizda mushukka kim **qaraydi**?

sentences.text: Don't worry, the rain**'ll** stop soon — it never lasts long here.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olma, yomg'ir tez orada **to'xtaydi** — bu yerda hech qachon uzoq yog'maydi.

sentences.text: **What'll** happen to the old bazaar when they build the new mall?
sentences.translation: Yangi savdo markazi qurilsa, eski bozorga nima **bo'ladi**?

sentences.text: Your order**'ll** arrive within three working days.
sentences.translation: Buyurtmangiz uch ish kuni ichida **yetib keladi**.

sentences.text: I **won't** be long — I'm just popping out to the bank.
sentences.translation: **Uzoq qolib ketmayman** — bankka bir chiqib kelaman, xolos.

sentences.text: **It'll** take at least an hour to get to the airport in this traffic.
sentences.translation: Bu tirbandlikda aeroportga yetib borish kamida bir soat **oladi**.

sentences.text: **We'll** never forget the hospitality we received in Khiva.
sentences.translation: Xivada ko'rgan mehmondo'stligimizni hech qachon **unutmaymiz**.

examples.title: Less common negatives: **mightn't**, **daren't**, **shan't**
examples.description: Kamroq uchraydigan inkor qisqa shakllar (asosan Britaniyada): mightn't, oughtn't, daren't, shan't, needn't; aren't I? — am not ning so'roq shakli; isn't = 's not, aren't = 're not.

sentences.text: I **daren't** tell my father that I've crashed his car.
sentences.translation: Dadamga mashinasini urib olganimni aytishga **jur'at qilolmayman**.

sentences.text: We **shan't** be needing the car tomorrow, so you can borrow it.
sentences.translation: Ertaga bizga mashina **kerak bo'lmaydi**, olib tursang bo'laveradi.

sentences.text: I'm invited too, **aren't** I? — Of course you are!
sentences.translation: Meni ham taklif qilishgan, **shunday emasmi**? — Albatta!

sentences.text: You **oughtn't** to drive when you're this tired.
sentences.translation: Bunchalik charchagan holda mashina **haydamasligingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: It **mightn't** be a good idea to mention the salary in your first interview.
sentences.translation: Birinchi suhbatda maosh haqida gapirish yaxshi fikr **bo'lmasligi mumkin**.

sentences.text: She**'s not** coming tonight — she's got a terrible cold.
sentences.translation: U bugun kechqurun **kelmaydi** — qattiq shamollab qolgan.

sentences.text: They **aren't** ready yet, and to be honest, they**'re not** even dressed.
sentences.translation: Ular hali **tayyor emas**, rostini aytsam, hatto **kiyinishmagan ham**.

sentences.text: **Isn't** it time we bought a new washing machine?
sentences.translation: Yangi kir yuvish mashinasi oladigan vaqtimiz **kelmadimi**?

sentences.text: Thank you, but you **needn't** wait for me — I'll get a taxi from the station.
sentences.translation: Rahmat, lekin meni **kutishingiz shart emas** — vokzaldan taksi olaman.

sentences.text: I **haven't** got any cash on me — **can't** we pay by card?
sentences.translation: Yonimda naqd pul **yo'q** — karta bilan **to'lay olmaymizmi**?

examples.title: Negative questions and tags: **Isn't it**? **Don't you**?
examples.description: Inkor so'roq va so'roq qo'shimchalarida qisqa shakl deyarli majburiy: Isn't it lovely? It starts at ten, doesn't it? To'liq shakl (Is it not ...?) — juda rasmiy (→ 52-dars).

sentences.text: **Isn't** it a lovely day? Let's have lunch in the garden.
sentences.translation: Bugun ajoyib kun, **shunday emasmi**? Tushlikni bog'da qilaylik.

sentences.text: You've met my cousin Shahlo before, **haven't** you?
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham Shahlo bilan avval **tanishgansiz-ku**?

sentences.text: **Don't** you think the prices in this café are a bit high?
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, bu kafedagi narxlar biroz baland **emasmi**?

sentences.text: Why **don't** we ask Farida to help us with the decorations?
sentences.translation: Bezaklarga Faridadan yordam **so'rasak-chi**?

sentences.text: The meeting starts at ten, **doesn't** it?
sentences.translation: Majlis soat o'nda boshlanadi, **to'g'rimi**?

sentences.text: **Wouldn't** it be cheaper to fly than to take the train?
sentences.translation: Poyezddan ko'ra samolyotda uchish arzonroq **bo'lmaydimi**?

sentences.text: **Haven't** you finished that report yet? It was due yesterday!
sentences.translation: Hali o'sha hisobotni **tugatmadingmi**? U kecha topshirilishi kerak edi-ku!

sentences.text: **Can't** you see I'm busy? Come back in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Band ekanimni **ko'rmayapsanmi**? O'n daqiqadan keyin kel.

sentences.text: **Didn't** I tell you the road would be closed? We should've gone the other way.
sentences.translation: Yo'l yopiq bo'lishini sizga **aytmaganmidim**? Boshqa yo'ldan borishimiz kerak edi.

sentences.text: "**Is it not** true that the company knew about the problem?" the lawyer asked.
sentences.translation: «Kompaniya muammodan xabardor bo'lgani **rost emasmi**?» — deb so'radi advokat.

examples.title: Formal style and emphasis: **do not**, **cannot**, **I am**
examples.description: Rasmiy xat, e'lon, shartnoma, ilmiy matn va imtihon inshosida qisqa shakl ishlatilmaydi: do not, cannot, it is. Og'zaki nutqda to'liq shakl urg'u beradi: I **am** listening!

sentences.text: Unfortunately, we **are not** able to refund tickets bought online.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, onlayn sotib olingan chiptalar uchun pulni qaytarib **bera olmaymiz**.

sentences.text: Passengers **must not** leave their luggage unattended at any time.
sentences.translation: Yo'lovchilar yuklarini hech qachon qarovsiz **qoldirmasliklari kerak**.

sentences.text: The management **cannot** accept responsibility for items left in the cloakroom.
sentences.translation: Ma'muriyat kiyimxonada qoldirilgan buyumlar uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga **ola olmaydi**.

sentences.text: I **am** writing to apply for the position of junior accountant.
sentences.translation: Kichik buxgalter lavozimiga ariza bilan **murojaat qilyapman**.

sentences.text: Applications that **have not** been signed **will not** be considered.
sentences.translation: Imzolanmagan arizalar **ko'rib chiqilmaydi**.

sentences.text: It **is** widely believed that the city was founded more than two thousand years ago.
sentences.translation: Shahar ikki ming yildan ko'proq vaqt oldin barpo etilgan, deb **hisoblanadi**.

sentences.text: I **do not** want to hear another word about it — is that clear?
sentences.translation: Bu haqda boshqa bir og'iz ham gap **eshitishni istamayman** — tushunarlimi?

sentences.text: I **am** listening! I just don't agree with you.
sentences.translation: **Eshityapman**-ku! Shunchaki siz bilan rozi emasman.

sentences.text: The committee **has not** yet reached a final decision on the matter.
sentences.translation: Qo'mita bu masala bo'yicha hali yakuniy qarorga **kelmadi**.

sentences.text: Should you have any questions, please **do not** hesitate to contact us.
sentences.translation: Savollaringiz bo'lsa, biz bilan bog'lanishdan **tortinmang**.

examples.title: Dialogue: an informal chat full of short forms
examples.description: Do'stlar o'rtasidagi norasmiy suhbat: deyarli har bir gapda qisqa shakl — 's, 'd, 'll, 've, n't, let's.

sentences.text: — Hey Timur, **where've** you been? I**'ve** been trying to call you all day.
sentences.translation: — Salom, Temur, qayerda **yurding**? Kun bo'yi senga qo'ng'iroq qilishga **urinyapman**.

sentences.text: — Sorry, my phone**'s** broken. I dropped it in the canal yesterday.
sentences.translation: — Kechir, telefonim **buzilgan**. Kecha uni ariqqa tushirib yubordim.

sentences.text: — Oh no! **Couldn't** you get it out?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Uni olib **chiqa olmadingmi**?

sentences.text: — I did, but it **won't** switch on. I**'ll** have to buy a new one.
sentences.translation: — Oldim, lekin **yonmayapti**. Yangisini sotib **olishimga to'g'ri keladi**.

sentences.text: — Well, **there's** a sale at the electronics shop near the metro.
sentences.translation: — Unda metro yonidagi elektronika do'konida chegirma **bor**.

sentences.text: — Really? **I'd** go today, but I **haven't** been paid yet.
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Bugun **borardim**, lekin hali maosh **olmadim**.

sentences.text: — **That's** no problem — **I'll** lend you some money till Friday.
sentences.translation: — **Muammo emas** — jumagacha senga pul qarz **berib turaman**.

sentences.text: — **You're** a real friend! **I'd** have asked my brother, but **he's** in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: — Sen haqiqiy **do'stsan**! Akamdan **so'ragan bo'lardim**, lekin u Buxoroda.

sentences.text: — **Let's** meet at the metro at six, then, shall we?
sentences.translation: — Unda soat oltida metro yonida **uchrashaylik**, maylimi?

sentences.text: — Perfect. And **don't** drop the new one in the canal!
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Faqat yangisini ariqqa **tushirib yuborma**!
